_about: Z09: zone world simulation (main loop, player tick, mobs, spawns, drops, scripts). Read from the zone send sites; client-facing ones checked against the 2016 client handler list. Field names are the 2017 PDB names where the 2016 code agrees.

0x240E.name: NC_BAT_HPCHANGE_CMD
fields: current HP minus vt 0x65c, floored at 0
0x240E.notes: sent from the player tick whenever the value differs from the last sent (+0x172d8)

0x245F.name: NC_BAT_LPCHANGE_CMD
0x245F.notes: player tick, on change; also sent to every object targeting the player (so_ply_Send2WhoTargetMe)

0x244A.name: NC_BAT_REALLYKILL_CMD
0x244A.basis: zone ShineMob::so_Routine FUN_0056baa0, ShineNPC::so_Routine FUN_0056a9e0, ShineMob::so_mob_SendReallyKill FUN_00553760; client FUN_004a28e0; pdb2016 lists 0x244A under two names, NC_BAT_PKINPKFIELD_WMS_CMD (Zone/WM enum) and NC_BAT_REALLYKILL_CMD (alt, struct {dead, attacker} = this layout); the zone sends the REALLYKILL layout (R2)
0x244A.notes: 2017 PDB alias of 0x244A (the zone→WM direction is NC_BAT_PKINPKFIELD_WMS_CMD, Z03). Sent once to sight when the mob's mode becomes 3.

0x2076.name: NC_ACT_ANIMATION_LEVEL_CHANGE_CMD
fields: MobConditionServer level; client stores it at char+0xb60

0x6C0B.name: NC_SCENARIO_OBJTYPECHANGE_CMD
fields: 5 acts as a mob, 4 as an NPC (inferred)

0x748D.name: NC_GUILD_MOBGUILD_CMD
0x748D.basis: zone ShineMob::so_mob_SetGuildRegNum FUN_00476110, ShineMob::mb_SendMyGuildInfo FUN_00475a80; client FUN_004ba6b0; field names from pdb2016 PROTO_NC_GUILD_MOBGUILD_CMD (R2)

0x201F.name: NC_ACT_SOMEONESHOUT_CMD
0x201F.basis: zone ShineMob::so_Shout FUN_00459250, ShineMobileObject::so_Shout FUN_00459080; client handler reads offset 1 as u16 for mobs (re-data/client-handlers.json 0x201f); 2017 PDB PROTO_NC_ACT_SOMEONESHOUT_CMD agrees
fields: 0 for mobs; link count for players
union: charID (player name, or a script-given name) / mobID (vt 0x708) when isMob
bits GMColor:1@0 (vt 0xef4), isMob:1@1 (pdb2016; mob version: speaker string empty); other bits stale in the mob version
text, then itemLinkDataCount × 0x67-byte item links (player version only)
0x201F.notes: to the whole map instance (target 0xFFFF) or one object. The mob version sends len + 0x1A bytes including the opcode, one stale byte more than the packet (Z09-B10).

0x1C0E.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_BRIEFINFODELETE_CMD
0x1C0E.basis: zone static packet `briefinfodelete` built by its dynamic initializer FUN_006951d0 (buffer 0x74df98, opcode 0x1C0E, payload pointer DAT_0074e028); sent by AxialListBriefDeleteAtMove::ali_Work FUN_004bdfe0 (ShineMobileObject::smo_OldObjectDelete FUN_004be0d0) and AxialListBriefDeleteAllOfRange::ali_Work FUN_005535c0 (player vt 0xdc4 / 0xdd0); client FUN_004b99f0
fields: handle of the object that left the receiver's sight
0x1C0E.notes: corrects Z02 §5 ('no zone code sends 0x1C0E'); client queues the handle in CharMgr.m_kmapDeletedChar (pdb2017) unless char+0x9be, removes minimap/decal/KQ marks

0x2049.name: NC_ACT_REINFORCE_RUN_CMD
0x2049.basis: zone ShinePlayer::smo_ply_ReinforceRun FUN_00566ab0 (player vt 0xe98, called by ShineMobileObject::so_MoveByServer FUN_00569510 with cmd 0x49); client FUN_004aa210
0x2049.notes: to the moved player only; client runs the main character there when its ground is free (only while main char +0x20 or +0x2c > 0)

0x204D.name: NC_ACT_REINFORCE_WALK_CMD
0x204D.basis: zone ShinePlayer::smo_ply_ReinforceRun FUN_00566ab0 with cmd 0x4D (no 2016 caller passes 0x4D, see Z09 §9.3); client FUN_004aa320; no PROTO struct in pdb2016 (R2)

0x204A.name: NC_ACT_REINFORCE_STOP_CMD
0x204A.basis: zone ShinePlayer::smo_ply_ReinforceStopHere FUN_00456ef0 (player vt 0xa50); client FUN_00499f10
0x204A.notes: to the player only, after every server-side stop (mm_Step stop, block-check rollback, teleport)

0x2069.name: NC_ACT_REINFORCERELOC_CMD
0x2069.basis: zone ShineMobileObject::so_ReinforceMove FUN_00459600; client FUN_004a4180; no PROTO struct in pdb2016 (R2)
fields: bit 0 = 'backwards' (facing kept: the client turns towards `from`); other bits stale g_buf content
0x2069.notes: no PDB struct; layout = PROTO_NC_ACT_SOMEONEMOVEWALK_CMD. Broadcast to sight (incl. the mover); used for knock-back / pull (Z03) and StaBodyForce shots

0x1C0A.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_DROPEDITEM_CMD
0x1C0A.basis: zone ctor BriefInformationDropItem::BriefInformationDropItem FUN_005492d0 (header 0x1C0A, len 0x11) at drop+0x167, filled by ShineDropItem::so_ItemDrop FUN_0052a7a0; sent by ShineDropItem::so_SendMyBriefInfo FUN_00555280 (drop vt 0x4c8) from ShineObject::so_drpitm_BriefInfo FUN_00567ff0; PDB PROTO_NC_BRIEFINFO_DROPEDITEM_CMD size 0xf; pdb2016 agrees (R2)
fields: drop position after the spiral placement
bits rareness:3@0 (always 0), looting:1@3 (pdb2016) = the receiving player may pick it (drop vt 0x538 so_drpitm_CanLootingBitSet, recomputed per receiver before each send)
0x1C0A.notes: one shared buffer per drop: the pickable bit is rewritten for each receiver just before the send; re-broadcast to the sight when the owner-only time ends and when a dice winner fails to pick

0x303B.name: NC_ITEM_DICE_GAME_CMD
0x303B.basis: zone ShineDropItem::so_DiceItemPickInit FUN_00531020; client GameFrameWork::On_NC_ITEM_DICE_GAME_CMD FUN_0049c530
fields: BelongDice.shn DiceTimeLimit (15), default 15 when the table is empty
0x303B.notes: to every party/raid member within 1000 units of the picker (2..20 players); the client opens RollingDiceWin with this item and timer

0x303E.name: NC_ITEM_DICE_GAME_START_CMD
0x303E.notes: to every participant on the roller's map who is still in the party/raid; client prints '%s rolled the dice and the result was %d.' or '%s decided to give up the chance to roll the dice.'

0x303F.name: NC_ITEM_DICE_GAME_RESULT_CMD
0x303F.basis: zone ShineDropItem::sd_DiceGameSendMsgResult FUN_0052ee60 from ShineDropItem::sd_DiceGameResult FUN_00531470; client FUN_004b2750
fields: drop+0x195 item ID at send time
0x303F.notes: to every participant still in the party/raid; client: 0x2008 → '%s acquired the %s item by rolling %d with the dice.' if PickItemID is a known item, else the error text

0x301B.name: NC_ITEM_PICKOTHER_ACK
fields: handle of the member who receives it
0x301B.notes: to the player who clicked, only when the receiver is someone else; the 2016 client has no handler (C01: dropped)

0x1C0C.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_MAGICFIELDSPREAD_CMD
0x1C0C.basis: zone BriefInformationMagicField ctor FUN_00549330 (length 0x12), filled in ShineMagicField::so_mgcfld_MagicFieldSpread FUN_0057ea30 / _Friend FUN_0057ee80, sent by vt 0x4c8 (folded FUN_00555280); client GameFrameWork::On_NC_BRIEFINFO_MAGICFIELDSPREAD_CMD FUN_004a09b0 → MagicField::AddMagicField FUN_00611a60; layout = pdb2016 PROTO struct
fields: ActiveSkill ID of the field skill
ActiveSkill.Area / 2 (the client does not use it)
0x1C0C.notes: 16 bytes; to every player in sight at the spread and to players walking into sight (Z09 §12.6)

0x1C0D.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_MAGICFIELDINFO_CMD
0x1C0D.notes: never sent by the 2016 zone: the batch counter is never incremented (original bug Z09-B27)
